title: Enterprise Connectivity: support entitlement for issuance
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this support entitlement for issuance rule to net transfer invoice.

## Basis: support fraction
For net transfer invoice, read portfolio reduction fraction from the unique active Support holding of this customer and legal billing entity, using zero if none exists.

## Basis Q&A
**What governs net transfer invoice here?** Read portfolio reduction fraction from the unique active Support holding of this customer and legal billing entity, using zero if none exists.

## No matching holding case
For a hypothetical net transfer invoice with no active Support holding matching both the customer and legal billing entity, the assistance fraction is zero. An active holding for a different legal billing entity does not provide a matching entitlement.
